violation_type.title: Required Admission Information- Permission to Transport, Including Pick-Up and Drop-Off Locations (26 TAC §744.605(8))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information- Permission to Transport, Including Pick-Up and Drop-Off Locations
violation_type.typical_finding: The enrollment forms do not have permission from the parents of the children for transporation from school to the operation.

finding_variants.text: The enrollment forms do not have permission from the parents of the children for transporation from school to the operation.
